verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents an official Web SDK with a detailed method-level reference: client creation from a session token, connect, quotes, buy, Apple Pay, Google Pay and auth frames, and credential retrieval. It also offers a guide for generating type-safe clients from its OpenAPI spec and a clone-able official demo-integrations repo. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond the Web SDK (server-side or mobile languages), a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (probes of standard paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
